svg.title: Security semantic sigil (Mosofin)
svg.desc: Verbatim geometry from mosofin/renderers/shared/utils.mjs SIGIL_SHAPE.security (tone security). In the viewer the group is placed at translate(nodeX+6, nodeY+6) scale(0.6875) and inherits fill none, stroke currentColor, stroke-width 1.35, round caps and joins, opacity 0.76. currentColor resolves to --security-stroke: #e11d48 (light) / #e11d48 (dark).
